programme_name_exact: Master in AI & Data Analytics for Business
entry_requirement_note: Explicit track rule: the Regular Track is "mandatory for participants who have 3 years of higher education (3-year Bachelor, Licence/'Bac+3') validated by an official degree equivalent to 180 ECTS credits"; the Fast Track (exemption from the 3rd term) is only for those with "4 years of higher education ... equivalent to at least 240 ECTS credits". A 180-ECTS Licence holder is admissible but is locked into the longer Regular Track (EUR 23,300 vs EUR 20,300). Subject entry: Bachelor in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Statistics or similar.

institution: Ecole Polytechnique (Institut Polytechnique de Paris) and HEC Paris
programme_name_exact: Master of Science Data Science & AI for Business (X-HEC)
entry_requirement_note: Admissions page states only that candidates must "hold at least a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution" (Bachelor in Science, Engineering, Business or Economics) and demonstrate "a strong level in Mathematics". No minimum credit volume and no 4-year/240-ECTS requirement is published; the floor is therefore unstated rather than absent.

programme_name_exact: Master Systemes d'information, Reseaux et Numerique (M2 parcours Big Data et Digital Economy)
entry_requirement_note: HARD EXCLUSION at this entry point. Direct M2 recruitment at Dauphine-PSL is open to "Students who have completed a BAC+4 degree (a four-year degree worth 240 ECTS credits)" or equivalent; holders of BAC+5 (300 ECTS) may also be considered. A 180-ECTS Licence does not qualify for M2. Dauphine's central master admissions page explicitly directs Bachelor holders elsewhere: "Nous invitons les etudiants venant d'un Bachelor a postuler directement en MASTER 1" - i.e. the applicant must enter at M1 (which requires 180 ECTS) and complete M1 before this M2. Quote taken from the admissions page of a sibling M2 in the same mention (Systemes d'information, Reseaux et Numerique); the Big Data et Digital Economy page carries no separate admissions tab.

180-ECTS bachelor accepted. No 210/240 floor. Subject-specific credit requirement, one of two options must be met: (1) "mindestens 30 ECTS aus den Fachgebieten Betriebswirtschaftslehre und/oder Volkswirtschaftslehre" PLUS "mindestens 24 ECTS aus den Fachgebieten Statistik und/oder Mathematik und/oder Wirtschaftsinformatik und/oder Informatik"; or (2) "mindestens 48 ECTS" from the statistics/maths/business-informatics/computer-science group. Minimum GPA 2.5 (German scale). Applicants not yet graduated must show 80% of credits (144 of 180).

Zugangs- und Zulassungsordnung vom 15.01.2024, Sec. 2(1): access requires "die Absolvierung eines fachlich einschlaegigen Studiums mit einer Regelstudienzeit von mindestens sechs Semestern" completed with a bachelor or other professionally qualifying degree at grade 2.9 or better. Six semesters = 180 ECTS, so a 3-year 180-ECTS degree meets the volume requirement exactly. Subject-specific: "mindestens 72 Leistungspunkte aus den Fachgebieten Quantitative Methoden, Computer Science, Information Systems und Business Administration", of which "mindestens 24 Leistungspunkte aus dem Gebiet des gewaehlten Schwerpunktes (Major)". Credits are mapped by competence, not module title. C1 English required.

programme_name_exact: Master's in Analytics and Artificial Intelligence
entry_requirement_note: Admissions page requires only "A previous degree (at least Bachelor's equivalent) with excellent grades" plus evidence of strong quantitative skills (BAT/GMAT/GRE may be required). No ECTS volume, no years-of-study minimum and no statement on 3-year degrees is published anywhere on the programme or admissions pages. AMBIGUOUS - as a private German business school ESMT is not bound by the state 210-ECTS conventions, but this must be confirmed directly with admissions@esmt.org before relying on it.

Programme page states only: "you need to have successfully completed a relevant bachelor's degree or another equivalent higher education qualification, as well as English language skills at level B2". No ECTS volume is published on the programme page or the central Application and Admission page; the university's Zulassungsrichtlinien Masterstudium and the programme's legal regulation (linked as uni.li/en/legal?id=304.67) could not be retrieved (404 / no content served). AMBIGUOUS - secondary indications point to a 180-ECTS minimum in line with other uni.li master programmes (e.g. MSc Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Leadership requires 180 ECTS incl. 60 ECTS business subjects), but this was NOT confirmed on an official page and must be verified with master.information-systems@uni.li.

institution: Catolica-Lisbon School of Business and Economics - Universidade Catolica Portuguesa
entry_requirement_note: No credit floor published. Admissions page describes a "Qualitative Evaluation Process" in which "the CV is the most valued document" and lists required documents (CV in English, "Transcript of Records (courses, grades, and ECTS)", application fee). The FAQ asks for "an undergraduate degree within the last three years" - a recency condition, not a duration or credit condition - and "recommend[s] a bachelor degree in Management, Economics or other quantitative background". Portuguese second-cycle access is governed by DL 65/2018 art. 17 (holders of a licenciatura, normally 180 ECTS in Portugal, or an equivalent foreign first-cycle Bologna degree), which is favourable, but Catolica-Lisbon publishes no programme-level number.

institution: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE) - Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
entry_requirement_note: No credit floor published. The Masters Eligibility page states only that "Programs target candidates with 0-2 years of professional experience", that "Nova SBE reserves the right to admit only applicants from accredited and/or recognized schools", and that a B2 English certificate is required. Programme-level entry is described by background, not credits: candidates from first-cycle programmes in Sciences, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Finance or Management, with maths and programming at entry level; a mandatory Python/Coding bridging course in August for those with limited programming. Enrolment is conditional on delivering an official Licenciatura completion certificate within the first month of classes.

institution: UPF Barcelona School of Management - Universitat Pompeu Fabra
programme_name_exact: Master of Science in Management specialization in Business Analytics
entry_requirement_note: No ECTS floor - and notably NOT the Spanish 240-ECTS grado volume. UPF's official master access requirement is a "Titol universitari oficial de grau o de master universitari de l'Espai Europeu d'Ensenyament Superior (EEES) o titol estranger equivalent que permeti accedir a un postgrau universitari en el pais que ha expedit el titol" - i.e. a foreign degree qualifies on the test of whether it grants access to postgraduate study in the issuing country, not on credit count. A Tunisian 3-year Licence grants access to a Mastere in Tunisia and so meets the stated criterion, subject to UPF's equivalence check (non-EHEA degrees without homologation require a request for recognition of equivalence of level).

institution: Esade Business School - Universitat Ramon Llull
programme_name_exact: Master of Science in Business Analytics
entry_requirement_note: No ECTS floor published. Admissions page: "An undergraduate degree that entitles you to undertake postgraduate studies in the degree-granting country is a necessary requirement for admission." The test is postgraduate-access entitlement in the issuing country, not credit volume, so a Tunisian 180-ECTS Licence satisfies the published wording. Subject profile: business administration or a strongly scientific/technical background (engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, bioinformatics, computer programming, computer science, information systems). Non-business backgrounds take the Business Integration Path (BIP); business backgrounds take the Pre-Program in Data Science.

institution: IE University - IE School of Science and Technology
programme_name_exact: Master in Business Analytics and Data Science
entry_requirement_note: No ECTS floor published. The admissions requirement is simply "Bachelor degree from an accredited university" (with a footnote that "Possible additional legalization and/or translation requirements might be applicable"), plus official transcripts, CV, personal statement, two references, GMAT/GRE/ieGAT entrance exam and English certificate (TOEFL 100+/IELTS 7+/Duolingo 130+). No duration, credit-count or 240-ECTS grado condition appears anywhere in the admissions and fees page.

programme_name_exact: Master of Science in Business Analytics
entry_requirement_note: FAVOURABLE and explicit. UNIGE's general master admission condition requires "un premier diplome universitaire (bachelor ou titre juge equivalent)" from a university and programme recognised by UNIGE, obtained after a minimum of 3 years of study, i.e. at least 180 ECTS (unige.ch/conditions/MA). AUFLAGEN: the GSEM programme directive provides that "The Scientific Committee may require some candidates for the Master in Business Analytics to complete Bachelor-level courses, 'Business Analytics', representing no more than 6 ECTS credits during the first semester of the Master's program." This is a maximum 6-ECTS co-requisite taken inside the master, not a bridging year. Applicants from outside GSEM must supply descriptions of prior statistics/probability/computing courses. English B2 required.

CRITICAL - 210 ECTS REQUIRED, MAKE-UP ROUTE AVAILABLE. Applicants "must hold a degree equaling at least 210 ECTS credits". For a 180-ECTS holder: "Applicants who have obtained 180 ETCS credits in a six-semester program may only be offered conditional admission" and are "required to obtain additional 30 ECTS credits while enrolled in the Master's program" (or prove equivalent prior practical/academic achievements, which can be recognised). So the applicant is admissible but carries a 30-ECTS make-up obligation on top of the 90-ECTS master. Degree must be in Digital Games or a closely related field (Game Arts, Game Design, Game Programming); portfolio, application tasks and an online interview also apply.

institution: SRH University (formerly SRH Berlin University of Applied Sciences)
programme_name_exact: M.A. Film, Television and Digital Narratives
entry_requirement_note: No ECTS floor published for this programme. The programme page and its dedicated "Admission requirements in detail" page require only a "Degree (bachelor or diploma)" plus a portfolio of 5-8 film works, a list of 5 favourite films/series, English proficiency, CV and motivation letter, and note the programme "is suitable for graduates of all Bachelor's degree programmes". A bridging option exists but is not tied to credits: "If the GPA, subject or language requirements are not fully met for direct entry into the programme, we offer a 1-semester PreMaster programme at the SRH International College." AMBIGUOUS - SRH's institution-level admission rule is reported as accepting 180 or 210 ECTS, and this master is 120 ECTS over 4 semesters (180+120=300), which is consistent with 180 being sufficient, but no programme page states a number. Confirm with admissions.

Explicit and favourable, with a structural consequence. General master admission requires "210 ECTS for admission to the 3-semester Master's programme with 90 ECTS or a Bachelor's degree with 180 ECTS for admission to the 4-semester Master's programme with 120 ECTS." A 180-ECTS holder is therefore admitted, but to the longer 4-semester / 120-ECTS variant rather than the 3-semester one - the extra credits are absorbed by a longer master rather than by separate bridging modules. English proficiency TOEFL iBT 72 or IELTS 6.0 or equivalent. The programme is non-consecutive, so career changers are welcome.

No credit floor. The programme's own Fachspezifische Ordnung zur Feststellung der studiengangsbezogenen Eignung, Sec. 2, requires only "ein abgeschlossenes B.Sc.- oder B.A.-Studium oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss" in Medieninformatik, Informatik, Medientechnologien, Digitale Medien, Interaction/Experience Design, Mediendesign or a comparable programme, plus proof of knowledge of modern audiovisual media production technologies. Safety net in the university's Rahmenordnung Sec. 6(3): where a two-year master does require 240 ECTS, "Bewerber*innen koennen auch mit einem Bachelorabschluss mit weniger als 240 ECTS-Punkten zugelassen werden, wenn sie in der Pruefung zur kuenstlerischen Eignung nachweisen, dass sie ueber die fuer den Masterstudiengang erforderlichen Kompetenzen verfuegen." SEPARATE BARRIER (not ECTS): foreign applicants who did not obtain their school-leaving qualification at a German-language institution must provide DSH-1 or equivalent GERMAN language proof, despite the English-language description.

No total credit floor in the Studienordnung (MdU 38/2020). Sec. 2(1): admission requires "ein - mit mindestens 'gut' beendeter - fachlich einschlaegiger erster Hochschulabschluss", where relevant means computer science, media informatics or another technical-scientific programme with a high computer-science share; no ECTS volume is stated, so 180 is not barred. MAKE-UP CLAUSE, Sec. 2(3): "Sind andere der erforderlichen Kriterien nur teilweise erfuellt, entscheidet der Pruefungsausschuss. Gegebenenfalls kann der Pruefungsausschuss vom Bewerber/von der Bewerberin zu erbringende Zusatzleistungen festlegen" - the examination board may impose additional coursework. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC CREDITS (Application FAQs): Mathematics and Computer Science together "amounting to the equivalent of at least 90 ECTS points (approx.)", with at least 15 ECTS in Mathematics and 45 ECTS in Computer Science - this is the real risk for a Business Intelligence licence. Target GPA 2.0 or better; English B2. Non-EU/EEA applicants apply via uni-assist. WARNING: an automated summary of this PDF produced a fabricated quote of "mindestens 180 ECTS-Punkten"; that wording does NOT appear in the document.

programme_name_exact: Master in Creative Direction, Content & Branding
entry_requirement_note: No ECTS floor published. Admissions and fees page requires "Bachelor degree from an accredited university" (footnoted only for legalization/translation), official transcripts, CV, personal statement, references, entrance exam (GMAT/GRE/ieGAT) and English certificate. No duration, credit-count or Spanish 240-ECTS grado condition is stated for this 10-month official master.

institution: HEAD - Geneve, Haute ecole d'art et de design (HES-SO)
entry_requirement_note: FAVOURABLE. Governing HES-SO master admission rule: candidates must hold "a diploma from a higher education institution (Bachelor degree or equivalent title) obtained in a recognized higher education institution and programme by the HES-SO at the end of training lasting a minimum of 3 years (at least 180 ECTS credits)", and "Holders of foreign tertiary education titles recognized as equivalent to a Bachelor degree" are treated the same as Swiss diploma holders. HEAD's own Conditions et procedures d'admission aux etudes de Master require "un diplome de Bachelor de niveau universitaire ou HES ou un titre etranger juge equivalent" and reserve the right to scrutinise private-school and foreign diplomas (verification via admission.head@hesge.ch). Entry is by a two-round competitive concours (dossier/portfolio then a ~20-minute interview), which is the real selection hurdle, not credits. Programme page: no technical prerequisite. HEAD programme page: https://www.hesge.ch/head/formations-recherche/master-en-media-design

No credit floor. Rahmenordnung (RO 414.262.1) Sec. 22(1): admission to master programmes is open to whoever holds "a. einen Bachelorabschluss oder b. einen mindestens gleichwertigen Abschluss einer anerkannten oder akkreditierten Hochschule" - degree type only, no ECTS number. RO Sec. 5(1) confirms a ZHdK bachelor is 180 credits, so 180 is the domestic norm. The Studienordnung MA Design Sec. 4 adds nothing on credits ("Die Zulassung zum Studium stuetzt sich auf die Bestimmungen der RO") and only adds language requirements. Selection is by a staged Zulassungsverfahren with portfolio and a fachliche Eignungsabklaerung. Note ZHdK may also admit sur dossier candidates without a bachelor's degree in exceptional cases. I could NOT substantiate the third-party claim that applicants with 180 credits must prove additional academic training or make up credits during the master - no such clause appears in RO Sec. 19-24 or StO MA Design.

institution: ECAL - Ecole cantonale d'art de Lausanne
entry_requirement_note: FAVOURABLE. ECAL is a HES-SO school, and the HES-SO master admission regulation requires a "Bachelor degree or equivalent title ... at the end of training lasting a minimum of 3 years (at least 180 ECTS credits)", with foreign titles recognised as equivalent treated identically. ECAL's own Master requirements page states the subject condition - "Bachelor's degree in digital design, computer science or communication systems" - "or equivalent foreign certificate", and notes "ECAL evaluates title's equivalences. This procedure being relatively long, a request of examination (Diploma, transcripts & cv) must be submitted by email" ahead of the deadline. IMPORTANT: the 180-ECTS figure comes from the governing HES-SO regulation, NOT from ECAL's own page, which states no credit number. Certified translation required for documents not in FR/DE/IT/EN/ES. ECAL page: https://ecal.ch/en/admissions/master/requirements-portfolio/

FAVOURABLE and the least subject-restricted of the Swiss art-school entries. HES-SO master admission regulation requires a "Bachelor degree or equivalent title ... at the end of training lasting a minimum of 3 years (at least 180 ECTS credits)"; foreign equivalents are treated the same. On ECAL's Master requirements page, Film Studies is the one programme listed as requiring only a "Bachelor's degree" with no subject field attached (all other ECAL masters name a discipline); the programme page describes it as "aimed at the holders of a Bachelor's degree, or with equivalent experience". Foreign diplomas go through ECAL's equivalence examination, requested by email before the deadline. IMPORTANT: the 180-ECTS figure comes from the governing HES-SO regulation, NOT from ECAL's own page. ECAL page: https://ecal.ch/en/admissions/master/requirements-portfolio/
